title: Classic Italian Frittata
description: A simple and satisfying Italian egg dish that's perfect for breakfast, lunch, or dinner. It's made with just a few ingredients and is a great way to use up leftover vegetables.
instructions: In a large skillet, sauté the diced onion over medium heat until softened.
Add the diced ham and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and shredded mozzarella cheese.
Add the cooked onion and ham mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into a greased 9-inch pie plate.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the edges are golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
